title: Tarot, angel cards, and intuitive readings
answer: A card reading uses a symbolic deck to look at a question. Tarot is 78 archetypal images. Angel or oracle cards tend to be gentler and more direct. An intuitive reading leans on the reader's impressions. None of them lock a future in place. Her essay says that. Adie, Andre, and Lisa Maria read tarot. Robert reads a regular playing deck. Janel and Linn read angel cards. Lisa Seyring works in poems, not cards. That essay is under Library, then Articles. Do not read a website address.
